meaning: bright (in reference to personality or weather); cheerful

specialReadings.meaningStory: Read the spelling as 明日, tomorrow, with 後, after: the day after tomorrow.
specialReadings.readingStory: The day after tomorrow, ASA turns the calendar twice. ASA plus the sharp T in turns cues あさって.

specialReadings.meaningStory: The spelling combines 明, bright, and 日, day: picture tomorrow as the bright day ahead.
specialReadings.readingStory: Tomorrow, ASH will TAP at the window: ASH plus TA points to あした.
